newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Santos waiver on oil drill reports.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Santos waiver on oil drill reports.

text.p: Oil and gas producer Santos Ltd said on Thursday it had been granted a waiver by the Australian Stock Exchange on providing regular drilling reports on the progress of wells outside Australian jurisdiction and in the Timor Sea zone of co-operation with Indonesia.

The waiver was granted on condition that the information about drilling test results "remains in fact confidential", and that Santos report significant events deemed to have a material effect on its shares, it said.
The waiver would run until April 23, 1997.
A similar waiver was granted to the Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd in October after a dispute about the amount of information BHP had provided about a well in the Timor Sea.
BHP argued that weekly drilling reports had no international equivalent and could provide industry intelligence to competitors.
The ASX said a time limit on the waiver would allow it to examine the issues raised by BHP's application.
